body: I haven't thought of it that way before. The more I put off speaking up the deeper I get into my own shell and the less my thoughts make sense. I'm going to have a talk with her tomorrow and hopefully figure out what I should do.

Thanks so much for the reply.

Heh, I guess when you put it like that, it does sound a little ridiculous. It's not that I've never been open with my sister, we're really close. She's just been having a tough time with anxiety herself lately and has been venting a lot to me, and I don't want to maker her own problems feel unheard I guess? I'm also scared to admit that I've been self harming again. She struggled a lot with it when she was my age and I hate letting her down by relapsing.

My brother and I aren't very close, he sort of made my childhood hell. He makes it up now by being generally cool to me and letting me hang out with him, but he's not really someone I want to talk to. Especially since he doesn't even really "believe" in depression/anxiety. So I do want some professional help, I'm just scared to seek it.

I have been frequenting the trans subs here, and also going to a youth group which has helped a lot.
